title: Machine learning-enhanced insights into sphingolipid-based prognostication: revealing the immunological landscape and predictive proficiency for immunomotherapy and chemotherapy responses in pancreatic carcinoma.
summary: A LASSO-derived 10-gene sphingolipid risk score in 179 TCGA pancreatic adenocarcinoma cases stratified observed survival; time-dependent ROC analyses and cell-line drug-sensitivity assays in AsPC-1 and Panc-10.05 supported selected response predictions. Cohort-based modeling and two cell lines do not establish patient treatment benefit or external clinical validity.
